lines.cap: He played dead, and three thousand people came.
lines.say: He played dead, and three thousand people came.

lines.cap: Timothy Dexter. An eccentric rich man in Massachusetts, in the 1790s.
lines.say: Timothy Dexter. An eccentric rich man in Massachusetts, in the 1790s.

lines.cap: He wanted to know how people would react when he died. So he faked his own death.
lines.say: He wanted to know how people would react when he died. So he faked his own death.

lines.cap: He arranged a full funeral. Coffin, mourners, the lot. About three thousand people turned up.
lines.say: He arranged a full funeral. Coffin, mourners, the lot. About three thousand people turned up.

lines.cap: And he watched it all, from his own house.
lines.say: And he watched it all, from his own house.

lines.cap: But one thing upset him. His wife didn't cry enough. So afterwards, he beat her for it.
lines.say: But one thing upset him. His wife didn't cry enough. So afterwards, he beat her for it.

lines.cap: Then he walked out, very much alive, to a room full of shocked mourners.
lines.say: Then he walked out, very much alive, to a room full of shocked mourners.

lines.cap: Some people just need to know who'd show up.
lines.say: Some people just need to know who'd show up.
